entries.title: Kingdoms Reborn

emulation.notes: Use the native Steam release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC Steam Early Access version is the only sourced public release route found and is therefore both the highest-fidelity and most-complete playable version currently available.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Early Access release through Steam. Expect ongoing changes until the developer leaves Early Access.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC Steam Early Access release.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced public playable release route found.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: There is no platform split; the single playable route is Windows PC.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an Early Access game, not a remaster or definitive reissue; content and systems may continue to change.
